== Biography ==
'''Dosha Ann Rebecca Glasgow''' was born on June 22, 1831 in Weakley County, Tennessee, United States, daughter of [[Glascow-14|Isaac Wesley Glascow]] (1786–1848) and [[Cannady-99|Dosha Cannady]] (1792–1848).

Dosha married '''[[Adams-9473|George Washington Adams]]''' (born on April 18, 1827 in Virginia, United States; son of [[Adams-9442|John V Adams]] and [[Craddock-144|Nancy Ann Craddock]]). Their children were:
* [[Adams-9474|Sarah Jane Adams]] (~1852–~1852) 
* [[Adams-9475|William Green Adams]] (1853–1943) 
* [[Adams-9479|John Moses Adams]] (~1854–~1855) 
* [[Adams-9480|James Francis Adams]] (1855–~1856) 
* [[Adams-9481|Thomas Medlin Adams]] (~1856–~1858) 
* [[Adams-9482|Dosha Ann Adams]] (~1859–~1941) 
* [[Adams-9483|Kathryn Amanda Adams]] (~1861–1947) 
* [[Adams-9484|George Washington Adams]] (1863–~1893) 
* [[Adams-9485|Emily Belle Adams]] (~1865–~1953) 
* [[Adams-9486|Ellen Mexico Adams]] (~1871– )

In 1870, Dosha (39) was living in Census Weakley, Tennessee.

In 1880, Dosha (49) was living in Martins Store, Weakley.

In 1880, Dosha (49) was living in Martins Store, Weakley, Tennessee. <ref name="Census_1880">"United States Census, 1880," database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MDWV-X8Y : 15 July 2017), Rebecca Adams in household of George W Adams, Martins Store, Weakley, Tennessee, United States; citing enumeration district ED 166, sheet 142A, NARA microfilm publication T9 (Washington D.C.: National Archives and Records Administration, n.d.), roll 1284; FHL microfilm 1,255,284.</ref>

Dosha died about July 8, 1907 in Weakley County, aged about 76.

=== Original heirship review — 30 October 2026 ===
The existing father [[Glascow-14|Isaac Glasgow]] is now assessed at '''96% confident inference''', superseding the earlier 76% grade. The original 1851 Weakley deed calls its grantors the heirs of deceased Isaac Glasgow and conveys land originally surveyed in his name. The acknowledgment identifies Dasha A.R. as George W. Adams’s wife. The uncommon name, initials and husband match the existing Dosha Ann Rebecca and George Washington Adams couple, strengthening her identity within Isaac’s family. Numerous other heirs match Isaac’s existing family, including Elijah, William C., Wagstaff K., John G., Joseph D. and Jesse Glasgow, with the Adams couple. This supports confident fatherhood by the combined specific family group, rather than a generic same-name or age match.<ref name="WeakleyHeirs1851">[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSKJ-RS12-5 Weakley County Register of Deeds, pp. 410–411], DGS 008151469, image 213; deed 20 February 1851, acknowledgment 14 March, registered 15 March. Original inspected 30 October 2026.</ref>

The record directly states heirship, not a literal child clause. Husbands are among the grantors and are not treated as biological children. This is a profile-specific confident inference; full middle names, vital dates, mothers and upstream ancestry are not proved by the deed. The acknowledgment identifies Dasha A.R. as George W. Adams’s wife. The uncommon name, initials and husband match the existing Dosha Ann Rebecca and George Washington Adams couple, strengthening her identity within Isaac’s family.
